## Checks

- [ ] `npm test` passed.
- [ ] Positive and negative fixtures included.
- [ ] Community-only results inspected separately from built-in fallback.
- [ ] Image preview checked; OCR result reported separately if tested.
- [ ] No personal data, cookies, signature URLs or usable attendance codes.
- [ ] Toolkit files unchanged (otherwise describe the main-extension change and review).

## Limitations
